title: An Improved Lower Bound for the Hypergraph Ramsey Number R(6,6;4)
description: Explicit PSL(2, 619)-invariant 2-colouring F_620 of the 4-subsets of the 620-point projective line F_619 U {infinity} with no monochromatic 6-subset in either colour, establishing R(6, 6; 4) >= 621. Accompanied by a 5-page note (PDF/LaTeX), machine-readable JSON rule table (SHA-256: 6658e8cfc640c17e14b425f5b0a19bd03017ed1aba7a035752df5550199467c6), and zero-shared-code Rust and Python clean-room verifiers.
